signIn.title: Sign in to MoneyTrail
signIn.lead: Follow the trail of every cent: your accounts, your spending and where it all went.
signIn.failed: Signing in did not work. Use a Google account with a verified email address and try again.
signIn.scope: We only receive your name, email address and profile photo.
signIn.history: Edits never erase history: every change is kept.
signIn.noTrackers: No ads and no third-party trackers.
signIn.license: Open source under the MIT licence

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Spending by category this month, the six-month trend and the balance of each account.

forms.name: Name
forms.amountInvalid: Enter an amount in numbers, such as 1250.50.

errors.network: Could not reach MoneyTrail. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Reload the page and sign in again.
errors.badRequest: MoneyTrail could not accept these details. Check them and try again.
errors.stillSaving: Your previous attempt is still being saved. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: This no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.alreadySaved: An earlier attempt was already saved. Close this window and check the list.
errors.accountArchived: This account is archived. Pick another one.
errors.categoryArchived: This category is archived. Pick another one.
errors.alreadyReversed: This transaction was already reversed or edited. Close this window and open it again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lead: Everything you own and owe. All amounts in euros.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Add your bank accounts, savings, cash and credit cards to see what you own and owe.

accounts.allArchived: Every account is archived. Restore one or add a new one.
accounts.archiveHint: Hides it from lists. Its history is kept.
accounts.note: Each balance is the sum of every entry on that account, so it always adds up. Archiving an account hides it; it never deletes its history.

form.title: Add account
form.balanceHelp: Saved as an opening entry, so the history adds up from day one.
form.owedHelp: Saved as money you owe, so your net worth stays right.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: They sort your expenses and income. Archiving a category keeps its history.

nameTaken.EXPENSE: You already have an expense category with this name.
nameTaken.INCOME: You already have an income category with this name.

categories.archiveHint: No longer offered for new transactions. Its history is kept.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Expenses, income and transfers between your accounts.

noMatch.title: No transactions match
noMatch.description: Try another word or clear the filters.

empty.title: No transactions in {{month}}
empty.description: Record an expense, an income or a transfer, and it shows up here.

form.loadFailed: Could not load your accounts and categories.
form.descriptionRequired: Describe it in a few words.
form.transferNote: Transfers move money between your own accounts, so they never count as spending or income.
form.editNote: Saving reverses the original and records the corrected one. Both stay in the trail.
form.savedOnce: Saved once, even if you tap twice

noAccounts.title: Add an account first
noAccounts.description: Every expense, income and transfer moves money from or to one of your accounts.

detail.correctedSameAmount: Corrected after it was first recorded

confirm.title: Reverse this transaction?
confirm.description: We add an entry that cancels it exactly, so the balance goes back to what it was. Both entries stay in your history.

detail.oldVersion: This is an earlier version. An edit replaced it, so it no longer counts.
detail.reversed: Reversed. It no longer counts towards your balances or the month's totals.
detail.ledgerHelp: Every movement is recorded as postings that add up to zero.

trail.title: Trail
trail.note: Edits never overwrite history. MoneyTrail cancels the original with an exact opposite entry, then records the corrected one.
